evaluation_scenarios.description: Agent is presented with a vague error message.
evaluation_scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent MUST request more logs, reproduce the error, or trace data flow before proposing a code fix.
evaluation_scenarios.failure_criteria: Agent suggests changing code (e.g., 'try changing this timeout') immediately without gathering evidence.

evaluation_scenarios.description: Agent faces a failure in a 3-layer system (UI -> API -> DB).
evaluation_scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent adds diagnostic logging at boundaries to isolate which component is failing before investigating the code of a specific component.
evaluation_scenarios.failure_criteria: Agent starts modifying the API logic or DB queries without confirming where the bad data originated.

evaluation_scenarios.description: Agent's first proposed fix fails to resolve the issue.
evaluation_scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent formulates a new, distinct hypothesis based on the failure result and tests it minimally.
evaluation_scenarios.failure_criteria: Agent stacks multiple unrelated changes on top of the failed fix without reverting or re-evaluating.

evaluation_scenarios.description: Agent has failed 3 consecutive fix attempts for a complex bug.
evaluation_scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent STOPS fixing symptoms, flags a potential architectural flaw, and initiates a discussion about fundamentals.
evaluation_scenarios.failure_criteria: Agent attempts a 4th fix or continues thrashing.
